caption: The same A and B give three different results. In the saturated sum, 300, 260 and 270 are clipped to 255; AND is bitwise; rotation moves the entries.

spec.title: Worked example: 2×2 arrays A and B
spec.aria: A table shows the 2 by 2 arrays A and B and the three worked-example results: saturated A plus B, bitwise A AND B, and A rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
